services.desc: Only a short distance from the centre of Winnipeg, studio office space is available for those looking for a location that is situated in a spacious country lot with a view of the La Salle River. The St. Norbert Arts Centre exudes a sense of calm and seclusion. You will have a daily opportunity to enjoy the mature deciduous forest, the riverbanks, and wonderful gardens along with the extraordinary architecture of the Provincial Monastery Ruins. Meet the Board and our community of Artists and Tenants who have made SNAC their place to invest, create and grow. services.name: Solar Greenhouse
services.desc: There is a need on the Prairies to develop and practice methods of food production that require minimal or no dependence on unreliable petroleum fuel. The average meal travels over 2000 km before it is consumed in Manitoba, as fuel prices increase, the cost of food also increases, making it more difficult for people to access healthy food. The term “Food security” means production or availability of nutritionally adequate and safe food, access or capacity to access nutritionally adequate and safe food. blurb: The St. Norbert Arts Centre (SNAC) is a diverse community dedicated to the cultural, environmental, and spiritual preservation of its home-the historical Trappist Monastery site located in St. Norbert, a thriving community in the south of Winnipeg, Manitoba. We offer a setting for a multitude of diverse activities that range from art and music events to special occasion events staged for indoors or outdoors.
